messages:
Emma L: Heads-up — spotted flaky pagination in the sampleapp when client-side prefetch + concurrency are enabled. Repro steps below, happens consistently with small windows.

Emma L: repro: JS sdk v1.12.3, sampleapp `--concurrency=4 --prefetchWindow=2`. Requesting page-cursors ends up with duplicate items across pages (same id) and sometimes a skipped page. Logs:
```
INFO fetch page cursor=eyJ... page=2 items=50
WARN retrying fetch page=3 status=429 retry_count=1
INFO fetch page=3 items=50
INFO fetch page=3 items=50  <-- duplicate page returned from client cache
```

Raj P: oof. do you have a minimal repro app? can you paste the paginator config?

Emma L: minimal is the sampleapp with `--concurrency=4 --prefetch=2`. paginator init: `new CursorPaginator({pageSize:50, prefetchWindow:2, maxConcurrency:4})`. Also noticed `429 -> retry` path uses immediate retry in JS for the first retry (no backoff) which lines up with dupes when prefetch races.

Oliver: thanks emma. can you confirm the SDK version + whether you used `client-side-cache=true`? we recently landed an adaptive window change in JS that may be interacting.

Emma L: yes v1.12.3, cache=true (default in sampleapp). I also tried turning cache off and the duplication goes away but latency spikes.

Sophia: fyi oncall saw sampleapp e2e flakiness yesterday around 10:12 PDT — rate spikes to dedicated env caused a bunch of 429s. might be related.

Oliver: quick theory: JS retry schedule was changed in 1.12.x to immediate first retry (to reduce tail latency) but that can lead to overlapping fetches when prefetch kicks in, and our client cache dedupe key is only on (cursor,page) not on in-flight requests, so cache returns the same page twice when the retry completes. Go SDK uses jittered backoff so it avoided overlap.

Raj P: can you try two quick workarounds so we can mitigate: (1) set `prefetchWindow=0` in sampleapp; (2) set retry policy `initialDelay=100ms`? which one works better?

Emma L: tried prefetch=0 — no duplicates, but UX worse. Tried `initialDelay=100` — seems to remove dupes and preserve prefetch UX. So patchable client-side.

Oliver: good signal. I'll propose two fixes: immediate short-term patch to revert the immediate-first-retry behavior (make initialDelay=100ms default), and a longer-term fix to make cache dedupe consider in-flight request ids. I'll open a PR.

ci-bot: deploy pipeline started for branch: fix/paginator-retry-1.12.4 (job 4721) :gear:

Raj P: can you add a small integration test in sampleapp that runs concurrency/prefetch smoke to catch regressions? maybe a headless test that asserts unique ids across pages.

Oliver: yep — adding an e2e in sampleapp + unit for cache-inflight. will tag you for review.

Emma L: creating an issue with repro and logs now, will link the sampleapp PR. thanks all.

Emma L: issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/issues/231

Oliver: tracked in SDK: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/514 — revert immediate-first-retry and add inflight dedupe test. planning release patch 1.12.4 later today.

Sophia: once patch lands we'll run a quick dedicated env soak during low-traffic window to be safe.

Raj P: nice. can we also add a note to devex docs about "prefetch + aggressive retry" caveat so onboarded apps don't hit this blind?

Oliver: yes, adding a short blurb to devex/pagination.md and the sampleapp README.

Emma L: thanks — feel free to close once PR and sampleapp test merged. :thumbsup:
